words.meaning: Fresh, rich green vegetation or the lush green condition of growing plants.
words.sentence1: The spring downpours restored the dry foothills to their customary verdure. (The spring downpours restored the dry foothills to their customary verdure.)
words.sentence2: Flocks of sheep grazed contentedly amid the lush verdure of the river valley. (Flocks of sheep grazed contentedly amid the lush verdure of the river valley.)

words.meaning: Dew; moisture condensed from the atmosphere in small drops on cool surfaces at night.
words.sentence1: Las gotas de rocio resplandecian como diamantes sobre los petalos de rosa. (The drops of dew sparkled like diamonds on the rose petals.)
words.sentence2: Caminamos descalzos por la hierba humedecida por el rocio matutino. (We walked barefoot across the grass moistened by the morning dew.)

words.meaning: Hoarfrost, rime, or chilly winter fog that covers nature in cold weather.
words.sentence1: Les premiers frimas de l'hiver ont blanchi la cime des sapins sauvages. (The first winter frosts whitened the tops of the wild fir trees.)
words.sentence2: La plaine s'etendait silencieuse sous un voile epais de frimas. (The plain stretched silent beneath a thick veil of hoarfrost.)

words.meaning: Hoarfrost or rime; delicate ice crystals formed on outdoor objects during freezing nights.
words.sentence1: Ein zarter Raureif bedeckte die nackten Aeste der Eichen im Morgengrauen. (A delicate hoarfrost covered the bare branches of the oaks at daybreak.)
words.sentence2: Unter der Wintersonne glitzerten die mit Raureif ueberzogenen Wiesen wie ein Meer aus Kristall. (Under the winter sun, the frost-coated meadows glittered like a sea of crystal.)

words.meaning: A chilly wind blowing in late autumn or early winter that strips leaves from trees.
words.sentence1: Kogorashi ga fukiareru to, koen no kigi wa subete no ha o otoshita. (When the cold winter wind blew violently, the park trees dropped all their leaves.)
words.sentence2: Machikado de kogorashi o hada ni kanji, fuyu no otozure o satotta. (Feeling the cold autumn wind on my skin at the street corner, I realized winter had arrived.)

words.meaning: A light, gentle, and refreshing wind; breeze.
words.sentence1: Una tiepida brezza primaverile accarezzava i rami fioriti degli aranci. (A mild spring breeze caressed the blossoming branches of the orange trees.)
words.sentence2: Dalla collina scendeva una brezza profumata di pini e terra bagnata. (A breeze scented with pines and wet earth drifted down from the hill.)

words.meaning: White dew; cool moisture condensed on leaves during autumn, also marking the fifteenth solar term.
words.sentence1: Qingchen de bailu dian zhui zhe yezi, zai zhaoyang xia shan shan fa guang. (The morning white dew dotted the leaves, glittering brightly in the morning sun.)
words.sentence2: Bailu jieqi yi dao, tiandi jian de qiuliang bian riyi nonghou. (Once the White Dew term arrives, the autumn coolness in the world grows deeper each day.)

words.meaning: Autumn foliage; the vibrant red and gold turning of leaves in fall.
words.sentence1: Gaeuri gipeogalsurok gubigubi sanjarage danpungi bulgge muldeureotda. (As autumn deepened, the winding mountain slopes were dyed bright red with autumn foliage.)
words.sentence2: Saramdeureun nungil gadeuk pyeolchyeojin danpungeul gamseanghayeo supeul georeotda. (People walked through the woods to admire the autumn leaves spread out before their eyes.)

words.meaning: The rainy season or monsoon period, marked by abundant rains that rejuvenate nature.
words.sentence1: Nov pel rodov vossa chhoetong chea chroen rik reay doy sa tuk phlieng. (During the rainy season, many plants flourish due to the rainwaters.)
words.sentence2: Karkakor roeng cham rodov vossa daembi thveu srae chamkar oy sross khvei. (Farmers eagerly await the rainy season so their agricultural fields will thrive.)

words.meaning: Autumn; the transitional season when temperatures cool and foliage changes color.
words.sentence1: Gedurende die herfs verander die eikebome se blare na skakerings van goud en roesbruin. (During autumn, the oak trees' leaves change to shades of gold and rust brown.)
words.sentence2: Die koel lug van die herfs kondig die naderende winter aan. (The cool air of autumn announces the approaching winter.)
